belongs_to: Matchstick Patterns: 'Look at the picture below. It is a pattern using matchsticks. Can you identify what the pattern is?'
description: Four matchstick figures in a row, labelled 1, 2, 3, 4 below each (Step numbers). Pale yellow sticks with red-brown heads. Each step is a strip of equal triangles sharing sides, alternating apex-up and apex-down, the top row shifted to the right (parallelogram-like strip). Step 1: 1 triangle (apex up) = 3 sticks (1 horizontal bottom, 2 slanted). Step 2: 2 triangles (up, then down on its right) = 5 sticks (2 horizontal: top 1, bottom 1; 3 slanted). Step 3: 3 triangles (up, down, up) = 7 sticks (3 horizontal: top 1, bottom 2; 4 slanted). Step 4: 4 triangles (up, down, up, down) = 9 sticks (4 horizontal: top 2, bottom 2; 5 slanted). Each step adds 2 sticks; horizontal sticks = step number, slanted sticks = step number + 1. No highlighting. The step 4 figure is the widest.

belongs_to: Figure it Out Q5: 'In the following figure, observe how the expression w + 2 becomes 4w + 20 along one path. Fill in the missing blanks on the remaining paths. The ovals contain expressions and the boxes contain operations.'
description: Star-shaped path diagram. Ovals are grey-filled with italic text; boxes are small pale-yellow squares with a thin dark border. Centre: oval 'w + 2'. From the centre four black arrows (arrowheads at the far end) go diagonally outward to four boxes: top-left box '-5', top-right box '+3', bottom-left box '-8', bottom-right box '-4'. From each box a plain line runs horizontally outward (away from the centre) through a chain of oval - box - oval, and the chain ends with an arrowhead into the last oval (arrowheads point left on the left side, right on the right side). Top-left path: box '-5' - oval 'w - 3' - box '×3' - arrowhead to an EMPTY grey oval. Top-right path: box '+3' - oval 'w + 5' - box '×4' - arrowhead to oval '4w + 20'. Bottom-left path: box '-8' - EMPTY oval - box '-4' - arrowhead to an EMPTY oval. Bottom-right path: box '-4' - EMPTY oval - box '×3' - arrowhead to oval '3w − 6'. So there are 9 ovals (1 centre + 2 on each path) of which 4 are empty (top-left end; bottom-left middle and end; bottom-right middle) and 8 boxes (4 first-level boxes next to the centre, 4 second-level boxes).
unclear: The oval 'w - 3' prints its minus as a plain hyphen while the boxes use a longer minus; same meaning.
